scope: Conditional source-model fits of the recovered subset, not author-workflow reproduction or a replacement EOS
model: BM3 plus q-compromise Debye, n=20, Tr=298 K, V0=113.13 cm3/mol fixed; source gas constant float32(8.314)

cases.name: joint_recovered
cases.data: 45 expansion volumes plus 7 Zou 300 K relative volumes and all 40 Zou KS; 92 rows/channels

objective: Iterated effective-variance residuals in pressure; invert source KS(V,T) at each measured KS to obtain Pcalc; freeze weights within each least-squares solve, update after parameter optimization
weighting: Reported V errors for Milani; missing Milani T/P errors omitted from variance (not claimed zero physical error). Hartwig initial S2 assigned 1 percent T, 0.03 cm3/mol V; no increased multiplier. Zou reported P/KS/relative-volume errors and S2 assigned 2 percent T. No unknown correlations or normalization-anchor errors supplied.
normalization: Two independently fitted multiplicative instrumental volume scales; source original normalization anchors unrecovered. Zou volumes = published V/V0 times adopted molar V0; errors from published ratio error. No free Zou modulus scale.
source_integrity: No source cell corrected, no substituted lattice-derived Hartwig volumes, no synthesized missing rows, and no published EOS record changed.
stopping: One specified error protocol and four specified subsets; do not search weight multipliers, row masks, alternative model families or missing observations to force source parameter parity.
limits: At most 30 IRLS cycles per case, at most 400 nonlinear evaluations each solve. Numerical convergence status, bounds and coefficient differences retained. Conditional covariance is inverse weighted-Jacobian information, with residual scaling separately stated; no original confidence or workflow claim.
